purpose: Admission floor for the development/proof stand in deploy/local/. This is NOT a runtime lock: it pins no component, no image digest and no architecture policy. Production admission remains deploy/runtime-lock.json enforced by deploy/host-preflight.sh, and nothing here may weaken, replace or be substituted for either.
